title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Monitor Diagnostic Setting module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-monitordiagnosticsetting'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

diagnostics_resource_ids.type: object({ target_resource_id = string storage_account_id = optional(string, null) log_analytics_workspace_id = optional(string, null) eventhub_name = optional(string, null) eventhub_authorization_rule_id = optional(string, null) metric_enabled = optional(bool, true) })
diagnostics_resource_ids.description: "(Required) The map of diagnostics arguments required to configure Diagnostic Settings: object({ target_resource_id = "(Required) The ID of the resource for which to enable the diagnostic setting." storage_account_id = "(Optional) Specifies the id of a Storage Account where Diagnostics Data should be sent." log_analytics_workspace_id = "(Optional) Specifies the id of a Log Analytics Workspace." eventhub_name = "(Optional) Name of the EventHub." eventhub_authorization_rule_id = "(Optional) Event Hub Authorizaation ID." metric_enabled = "(Optional) Specifies if metrics enabled or not." })

enabled_log_category_group.description: (Optional) The name of a Diagnostic Log Category Group for this Resource. If set, only category_group will be used in enabled_log block; otherwise, all available categories will be used.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

log_analytics_destination_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the destination type for Log Analytics. Use 'Dedicated' for resource-specific tables or 'AzureDiagnostics' for the default table.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Diagnostic Setting for Azure resources.

name.description: The Name of the Diagnostic Setting.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Monitordiagnosticsetting' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
